calendarDiscovery.crawlerNotes: The local PDF matches the current official download by SHA-256. The live calendar page confirms Board approval March 10, 2026 and adds grade-specific graduation dates and summer-school endpoints. The October 7 homepage notice overrides the annual attendance schedule for October 9 and explicitly returns students October 14. Keep that closure in the regular calendar, but do not invent a make-up date. The original PDF dates yield 180 attendance weekdays; with the verified closure they yield 179 pending any later make-up announcement. Calhoun County, Florida uses Central Time, America/Chicago; do not confuse it with Calhoun City Schools in Georgia or districts in other states. Six of eight early-release dates state 1:00 p.m.; November 11 and March 19 do not. Staff planning within Christmas break does not add closures. School-specific ceremonies do not establish districtwide attendance. Summer meeting days and participant scope remain unverified, so only separate FAQ guidance is supplied. schoolAgePopulation is an unset ranking placeholder, not enrollment. No later school-year calendar was supplied or verified.

editorialSummary.heading: Check the dismissal time for each shortened day
paragraphs: Eight dates have early release, but they do not all come with a published pickup time. The calendar gives 1:00 p.m. for six of them, including September 30, December 18 and the May 28 last day. Veterans Day on November 11 and the Friday before spring break, March 19, are also shortened school days. Families need the school’s notice for the time on those two dates. All times here are Central Time.

The October schedule changed after the annual calendar was published. Schools closed for weather on October 9, immediately before the October 12-13 fall holidays. The district announced an October 14 student return. Later in the year, Christmas break extends through January 5 while teachers have two workdays. Students return January 6. Spring break is March 22-26, with a scheduled March 29 return.

May graduation plans depend on the school and grade. Blountstown High School graduates May 20 and Altha Public School May 21. The district’s online calendar also lists kindergarten ceremonies at Altha, Blountstown Elementary and Carr, plus Carr’s eighth-grade ceremony. Those school events take place before the district’s May 28 final day. Confirm ceremony arrival details with the school.

about.dataSource: The supplied one-page district PDF is byte-for-byte identical to the current official download. The district Calendars page states Board Approved March 10, 2026 and supplements the PDF with kindergarten and Carr eighth-grade ceremony dates. The October 7 district weather notice supplies the October 9 closure and October 14 return.
about.processing: The complete PDF was extracted and visually inspected. October 13 is represented once as a student fall holiday, with the teacher workday explained in the note. January 4-5 staff workdays are already covered by the official December 21-January 5 student break and do not create duplicate no-school events. The October 9 weather closure and still-published first grading-period endpoint share one canonical occurrence; the closure notice controls attendance. The notice does not announce a replacement grading deadline or make-up date. There are 207 weekdays from August 13 to May 28, with 27 student-free weekdays in the original PDF and one additional verified weather closure. The calculated current attendance figure is therefore 179, not a printed official total. Eight early releases include six explicit 1:00 p.m. dates; no clock time is inferred for Veterans Day or March 19. School-specific ceremonies use a non-attendance milestone status and do not close classes for other students. FTE surveys, pre-school planning, June 1 teacher work and regular-year-unrelated summer events are omitted.
about.updates: Checked the current district calendar page, matching PDF, homepage, the full October 7 closure notice and searches for later calendar or make-up changes on October 15, 2026. The annual PDF has not been rewritten to include the operational closure; no subsequent make-up date or changed grading deadline was verified. The web calendar also adds summer-school endpoints without daily participation details.
about.disclaimer: The reviewed attendance count may change if the district announces make-up arrangements. Use school notices for the two unspecified early-release times, ceremony instructions and summer-school participation. Calendar approval is supported by the web page, not by an approval date printed in the PDF.

faqs.question: When does Calhoun County’s 2026-2027 school year start and end?
faqs.answer: The first student day is Thursday, August 13, 2026. The last is Friday, May 28, 2027, with dismissal at 1:00 p.m. Central Time. August 3-12 planning dates are for staff before students begin.

faqs.question: What changed for the October 9 weather closure?
faqs.answer: The district closed all school sites Friday, October 9, 2026 because of the approaching storm. The closure connected with the October 12-13 fall holidays, and the district announced a Wednesday, October 14 return for students.

faqs.question: When is fall break, and do students attend on October 13?
faqs.answer: The scheduled fall holidays are Monday, October 12 and Tuesday, October 13, 2026. October 13 is a teacher PD/work day, with no student classes. The separate weather closure on October 9 extended that student break to five consecutive days including the weekend.

faqs.question: What are Thanksgiving break and return dates?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving holidays run November 23-27, 2026. Students are scheduled to return Monday, November 30. Including the weekends before and after, families have nine consecutive days without classes.

faqs.question: Do students return on January 4 after Christmas break?
faqs.answer: No. Christmas break for students runs December 21, 2026 through January 5, 2027. January 4 and 5 are teacher PD/work days within that break. Students return Wednesday, January 6.

faqs.question: When is spring break, and is March 19 a day off?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 22-26, 2027, with a scheduled return Monday, March 29. Friday, March 19 is an early-release school day. It is not an extra full day of spring break.

faqs.question: Which eight dates have early release?
faqs.answer: The dates are September 30, October 30, November 11 and December 18, 2026, and February 12, March 19, April 23 and May 28, 2027. Students are scheduled to attend on all eight dates.

faqs.question: What time are students dismissed on early-release days?
faqs.answer: The calendar gives 1:00 p.m. Central Time for September 30, October 30 and December 18, 2026, and February 12, April 23 and May 28, 2027. It gives no dismissal time for November 11 or March 19. Check your school’s notice for those two dates and for transportation arrangements.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a school holiday in Calhoun County?
faqs.answer: Wednesday, November 11, 2026 is listed as Veterans Day Early Release. Students attend and leave early; it is not a full-day student holiday. The calendar does not state the dismissal time.

faqs.question: Which holidays give students a long weekend?
faqs.answer: Labor Day on September 7, 2026, Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 18, 2027, and Presidents Day on February 15, 2027 are student holidays. Classes are scheduled to resume on the following Tuesday after each holiday.

faqs.question: Is Friday, October 30 a full day off for Halloween?
faqs.answer: No. October 30, 2026 is an early-release and professional-learning day, with students dismissed at 1:00 p.m. The printable calendar’s Halloween wording does not make that Friday a full-day holiday.

faqs.question: When do grading periods and the first semester end?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar lists October 9, 2026 as the first grading-period end, December 18 as the second grading-period and first-semester end, and March 12, 2027 as the third grading-period end. October 9 was later closed for weather; no replacement grading deadline was verified. December 18 has 1:00 p.m. early release, while March 12 is not marked as shortened.

faqs.question: When are report cards issued?
faqs.answer: Report Card Day is October 28, 2026, January 13, 2027 and March 31, 2027. The annual calendar does not give a final fourth-quarter report-card date or interim-report dates. Follow school reporting notices for those releases.

faqs.question: When are the 2027 high school graduations?
faqs.answer: Blountstown High School graduation is Thursday, May 20, and Altha Public School graduation is Friday, May 21, 2027. The annual calendar does not provide ceremony times. Check with the high school for arrival, tickets and location details.

faqs.question: When are kindergarten and Carr eighth-grade graduation ceremonies?
faqs.answer: The district calendar page lists Altha kindergarten on May 25 at 9:00 a.m., Blountstown Elementary kindergarten on May 26 at 9:00 a.m., and Carr kindergarten on May 27 at 8:30 a.m. Carr’s eighth-grade ceremony is May 27 at 9:15 a.m. Times are Central Time; confirm guest arrangements with the school.

faqs.question: Do graduation dates change the district’s last day for students?
faqs.answer: The district’s last student day remains May 28, 2027, with 1:00 p.m. early release. A school’s ceremony date does not set a districtwide day off. Graduating students should follow their school’s attendance and rehearsal instructions.

faqs.question: Has a make-up date been announced for the October weather closure?
faqs.answer: The reviewed October 7 closure notice does not assign a make-up date, and none was verified in the reviewed district materials. Check ParentSquare and district announcements for any later change; do not assume that a holiday or early-release day has been converted.

faqs.question: How many student days are shown by the current dates?
faqs.answer: The original PDF’s dates work out to 180 attendance weekdays. Including the October 9 weather closure leaves 179 on the reviewed schedule, before any later make-up change. These are calculated figures; the PDF does not print an annual student-day total.

faqs.question: Is summer school part of the regular May 28 student year?
faqs.answer: Summer school is separate. The PDF gives a June 2, 2027 start, and the district calendar page adds a June 30 end. Those endpoints do not mean every weekday is a required class day for every student. Contact the school for eligibility, actual meeting days and hours.

faqs.question: Where can I get the official calendar and later updates?
faqs.answer: The district’s Calendars page links the printable one-page PDF and lists additional grade-level graduation dates. It identifies the calendar as Board approved March 10, 2026. For changes after publication, check the district homepage, ParentSquare and school notices.
